svg.title: svjeez: animated SVGs from TypeScript
svg.desc: The title "Animated SVGs from TypeScript" rises in word by word and a yellow highlighter swipes under TypeScript. A little yellow chick hops in from the right and lands where the full stop goes. A hand-lettered note inks on above it, "that's one !", with an arrow pointing down at the chick, which looks the title over before it all fades for the next round.
